msf.description: Configure MSF (UK) radio clock input: enable/disable and specify serial device path.

wwvb.description: Configure WWVB (USA) radio clock input: enable/disable and specify serial device path.

dcf77.description: Configure DCF77 (Germany) radio clock input: enable/disable and specify serial device path.

min_snr.description: Minimum acceptable signal-to-noise ratio (0–100). Lower values accept weaker signals.

max_offset_ms.description: Maximum offset (milliseconds) between decoded time and system clock before the signal is rejected.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (quiet) to 5 (debug). Recommended: 2 for production.

device_params.description: List of optional device tuning parameters (e.g., AGC timeout, sync pulse width). Each entry adds a `device_<param> <value>` line.

fallback_ntp.description: List of NTP server hostnames to use if all radio clocks are unavailable.

serial.description: Serial port communication settings for radio receivers.

PORT.description: Port or device path passed to radioclkd. Usually a serial device (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0) or empty if configured via /etc/radioclk.conf.
